confirmed.cause: [F1][major][existing-in-scope] [/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host.go:24](/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host.go:24) through line 43 collects `limit` inputs before creating any Open or Run. With one queued job, limit 2, and the caller leaving input open, Serve waits for a second input while both lease slots remain available. This violates the explicit available-work contract; a caller that sends its next job after the first finishes deadlocks. This gate is also a regression from original/host.go's immediate first-job start. `TestReviewAvailableJobWithOpenInput` independently fails on Go 1.22.12 and 1.26.5, including three race/shuffle repetitions. Supplied controller failure is supporting context, not the basis of the finding. Primary remediation owner: Serve admission/lifecycle implementation (Architecture & Design).
confirmed.correction: [F1] Begin available jobs without waiting for a full batch or caller input closure. A batch may stop taking inputs when it would otherwise wait, provided it supervises its admitted work and preserves the cohort join/release barrier. Verify the one-available-job/open-input probe and a producer that waits for first-job completion before sending another.

confirmed.cause: [F2][major][existing-in-scope] [/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host.go:62](/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host.go:62) through line 75 consumes only Open results while started Runs report to the separate buffered `runs` channel; Run errors are read only at [line 82](/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host.go:82). If Run 1 fails while Open 2 cooperatively waits on `workCtx.Done()`, Serve waits for Open 2 and never reads the Run error that must trigger `cancel()`. The caller must cancel externally before the acquired lease can be closed and Serve can return. `TestReviewRunFailureCancelsPendingOpen` controls this interleaving and independently fails on both Go toolchains and under three race/shuffle repetitions. Once externally canceled, the Run error remains inspectable and the acquired lease closes exactly once; the defect is failure supervision, not discarded final error identity. The original implementation also failed to propagate Run failures; this is an unmet candidate outcome rather than a claim of entirely new error-loss behavior. Primary remediation owner: Serve failure controller (Correctness & Compatibility).
confirmed.correction: [F2] Supervise Open and Run completions together while acquisition is pending, cancel immediately on the first observed failure, retain every independent error, and then drain all starts/results before closing leases. Verify a Run failure while another Open waits for coordinated stop, plus the held-cleanup and never-started-lease probes.

confirmed.cause: [T1][major][existing-in-scope] [/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host_test.go:39](/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host_test.go:39) and lines 100-133 preload inputs and close the channel before work; lines 136-167 test empty/already-canceled input. No authored test requires a queued job to begin while a sparse caller channel remains open. Thus the important available-work contract is effectively unverified: the full authored suite passes while the candidate exhibits F1. The independent available-job probe and supplied controller check both fail that source path. Primary remediation owner: candidate contract tests (Testing).

[T2][major][existing-in-scope] [/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host_test.go:100](/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host_test.go:100) through line 122 gives the sibling Run immediate success, so the test does not require a worker failure to stop another Run or a pending Open. Independent pending-Open reproduction confirms F2 escapes the authored suite. In a separate disposable mutation, removing only the `cancel()` in the Run-error receive branch leaves all authored tests passing under `-race -count=5`, while `TestReviewRunFailureStopsSibling` fails because the sibling waits until external caller cancellation. This verifies an independently actionable missing assertion on the important coordinated-stop contract; it does not claim all join tests lack signal. Primary remediation owner: candidate failure-propagation tests (Testing).
confirmed.correction: Add failure-to-stop propagation assertions with waiting sibling Run and pending Open

confirmed.cause: [T3][major][existing-in-scope] [/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host_test.go:48](/private/tmp/go-independent-concurrency-service/candidate/host_test.go:48), lines 53-69 and 95, measure active Run callbacks and Close count; Close returns immediately. The declared capacity applies to acquired leases through completed Close, including never-started Run leases. In a separate disposable mutation, successful cohort Close calls are deferred until Serve returns: all authored tests pass under `-race -count=5`, but `TestReviewCapacityIncludesCloseCompletion` records three owned leases at limit 2 and fails. This is a verified gap in an explicitly important resource contract, requiring a held-Close/lease-count assertion independent of the production fix. Primary remediation owner: candidate resource-lifecycle tests (Testing).
